messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — SDK PR 412 depends on a runtime change (eng-runtime PR 256). Need to coordinate merge order and reviewers. runtime fixes KV-cache serialization, SDK adds new client param, and charts need a feature flag change.
Sam: What's the minimal safe merge order? runtime -> sdk -> console -> helm?
Maria: Yep. runtime (256) first so SDK can point at the new tag, then SDK (412), console only if it needs the new param, then charts.
Jia: I can review runtime today, aiming to get it merged by EOD. @Owen can you run the perf/integration job after I push fixes?
Owen: starting perf run now. I'll post results in this thread.
Sam: SDK is blocked on the runtime tag; I'll hold off merging until we have the tagged release.
Maria: CI note — helm tests failing because chart default for featureX changed. I'll open a small chart PR to avoid breakage.
deploy-bot: build started for eng-runtime#256 — unit tests queued.
Jia: pushed fixes addressing serialization edge cases, added unit tests, PTAL @Sam @Owen.
Sam: quick glance: API looks good, one nit on method name (Client.Send -> Client.Enqueue). Leaving comment.
Sam: approving pending the rename.
Sam: also I'll update go.mod once runtime is tagged; command I'll run:
```
# in sdk repo
go get github.com/redwood/eng-runtime@v1.12.0
git commit -am "bump runtime to v1.12.0"
```
Owen: perf/integration looks clean, latency tail slightly better with the serialization fix. Green from my side.
deploy-bot: eng-runtime#256 unit tests passed, integration job started.
Maria: can we target merge after 14:00 PT to avoid heavy traffic?
Sam: +1, sounds good.
Jia: merged eng-runtime#256 at 14:05 PT and pushed tag v1.12.0.
Sam: bumped SDK to v1.12.0 and ran CI — all checks green. Pushed SDK PR update.
Maria: console PR 998 needed a small change to pass schema validation, fixed and merged at 14:40 PT.
Maria: opened charts/main#120 to add featureX.enabled: true in values.yaml and to default toggle handling.
Owen: running helm lint/test against staging cluster.
Owen: helm tests passed in staging.
deploy-bot: charts/main#120 CI passed.
Maria: merging charts main#120 at 15:12 PT. Thanks all. I'll add a short runbook for cross-repo merge order so this is less manual next time. :tada:
Sam: I'll add a changelog note for the SDK bump.
Maria: Follow-up action items: 1) short runbook in eng-platform repo 2) add a checklist to PR template about cross-repo deps 3) tag owners for future merges.
Sam: noted, will create PR for checklist.
Jia: thanks everyone for quick reviews.
Owen: happy to monitor post-merge perf for the next hour.
Maria: closing the thread — everything merged and deployed to staging.
